description: Get the XCH balance of an address or puzzle hash. Sums all unspent coins (paginated). Accepts xch/txch addresses (network auto-detected from prefix) or a 32-byte hex puzzle hash (network defaults to mainnet, override with `network`).

address_or_puzzle_hash.description: An xch/txch bech32m address OR a 32-byte hex puzzle hash (optional 0x prefix)

network.description: Chia network: 'mainnet' or 'testnet11'. Optional — auto-detected from address prefix when an address is supplied.

name: get_balance
